items.question: Trong câu "Business requirements are the set of information that describes a business need leading to one or more projects, together with the desired ultimate business outcomes.", từ "ultimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Business requirements are the set of information that describes a business need leading to one or more projects, together with the desired ultimate business outcomes.", what does "ultimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ultimate /ˈʌl.tɪ.mət/ (tính từ): sau cùng, rốt cuộc. "Ultimate outcome/goal" = kết quả/mục tiêu sau cùng mà doanh nghiệp muốn đạt; nghĩa khác "the ultimate phone" = tốt nhất.
items.explanationEn: ultimate /ˈʌl.tɪ.mət/ (adjective): final, coming at the end. "Ultimate outcome/goal" is the final result the business wants; in "the ultimate phone" it means the best.

items.question: Trong câu "They set the context and objectives that user and functional requirements must align with.", từ "align" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They set the context and objectives that user and functional requirements must align with.", what does "align" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: align /əˈlaɪn/ (động từ): phù hợp, khớp với. "Align with something" = phù hợp/nhất quán với điều gì; yêu cầu người dùng phải khớp với mục tiêu kinh doanh.
items.explanationEn: align /əˈlaɪn/ (verb): to agree or fit with. "Align with something" means to be consistent with it; user requirements must fit the business objectives.

items.question: Trong câu "A project without a clearly defined and well-communicated direction invites disaster.", từ "invite" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A project without a clearly defined and well-communicated direction invites disaster.", what does "invite" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: invite /ɪnˈvaɪt/ (động từ): chuốc lấy, dễ dẫn tới. "Invite disaster/trouble" = tự chuốc lấy thảm họa/rắc rối; nghĩa thường gặp khác là "mời".
items.explanationEn: invite /ɪnˈvaɪt/ (verb): to make something bad likely. "Invite disaster/trouble" means to make a bad result likely; its everyday sense is to ask someone to come.

items.question: Trong câu "Participants can unwittingly work at cross-purposes if they hold different objectives and priorities.", từ "unwittingly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Participants can unwittingly work at cross-purposes if they hold different objectives and priorities.", what does "unwittingly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: unwittingly /ʌnˈwɪt.ɪŋ.li/ (trạng từ): một cách vô tình. Unwittingly = không hề hay biết; trái nghĩa với deliberately/knowingly (cố ý).
items.explanationEn: unwittingly /ʌnˈwɪt.ɪŋ.li/ (adverb): without realising it. Unwittingly means without being aware; the opposite of deliberately or knowingly.

items.question: Trong câu "Participants can unwittingly work at cross-purposes if they hold different objectives and priorities.", từ "at cross-purposes" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Participants can unwittingly work at cross-purposes if they hold different objectives and priorities.", what does "at cross-purposes" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at cross-purposes /æt ˌkrɒsˈpɜː.pə.sɪz/ (cụm từ): ngược mục đích nhau. "Work/talk at cross-purposes" = làm/nói theo những mục đích trái ngược mà không nhận ra.
items.explanationEn: at cross-purposes /æt ˌkrɒsˈpɜː.pə.sɪz/ (phrase): with conflicting aims. "Work or talk at cross-purposes" means pursuing conflicting aims, often without noticing.

items.question: Trong câu "Customers linger longer in the store and spend more", từ "linger" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Customers linger longer in the store and spend more", what does "linger" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: linger /ˈlɪŋ.ɡər/ (động từ): nán lại, lưu lại lâu. "Linger in the store" = nán lại trong cửa hàng; nhà bán lẻ muốn khách ở lâu để mua nhiều hơn.
items.explanationEn: linger /ˈlɪŋ.ɡər/ (verb): to stay somewhere longer. "Linger in the store" means to stay there longer; retailers want this so customers buy more.

items.question: Trong câu "The project decision makers must resolve that conflict before the BA details the requirements.", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The project decision makers must resolve that conflict before the BA details the requirements.", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (động từ): giải quyết, dàn xếp. "Resolve a conflict/issue" = giải quyết xung đột/vấn đề; "resolve to do" lại là quyết tâm làm gì.
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (verb): to settle a problem. "Resolve a conflict or issue" means to settle it; "resolve to do something" means to decide firmly.

items.question: Trong câu "The focus should be on delivering maximum business value to the primary stakeholders, avoiding distraction by superficial product characteristics that do not address the business objectives.", từ "superficial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The focus should be on delivering maximum business value to the primary stakeholders, avoiding distraction by superficial product characteristics that do not address the business objectives.", what does "superficial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: superficial /ˌsuː.pəˈfɪʃ.əl/ (tính từ): hời hợt, bề ngoài. "Superficial characteristics" = đặc điểm bề ngoài, không giải quyết mục tiêu thật; trái nghĩa với fundamental.
items.explanationEn: superficial /ˌsuː.pəˈfɪʃ.əl/ (adjective): shallow, on the surface. "Superficial characteristics" are surface features that do not serve real goals; the opposite of fundamental.

items.question: Trong câu "As more constituencies climb aboard, scope grows.", từ "constituency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As more constituencies climb aboard, scope grows.", what does "constituency" (noun) mean?
options: khu vực bầu cử tại địa phương
bản hiến pháp của quốc gia
ban giám đốc của công ty
nhóm có quyền lợi liên quan
items.explanation: constituency /kənˈstɪtʃ.u.ən.si/ (danh từ): nhóm có quyền lợi liên quan. Ở đây constituency = nhóm người có lợi ích/tiếng nói trong dự án; trong chính trị nó là khu vực bầu cử.
items.explanationEn: constituency /kənˈstɪtʃ.u.ən.si/ (noun): a group with shared interests. Here a constituency is a group with a stake in the project; in politics it means an electoral district.

items.question: Trong câu "Uncontrolled scope creep can cause a project to topple under its own weight.", từ "topple" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Uncontrolled scope creep can cause a project to topple under its own weight.", what does "topple" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: topple /ˈtɒp.əl/ (động từ): đổ sụp, sụp đổ. "Topple under its own weight" = sụp đổ vì chính sức nặng của mình (quá nhiều yêu cầu).
items.explanationEn: topple /ˈtɒp.əl/ (verb): to fall over, to collapse. "Topple under its own weight" means to collapse because it has grown too heavy.

items.question: Trong câu "No organization should initiate a project without a clear understanding of the value it will add to the business.", từ "initiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No organization should initiate a project without a clear understanding of the value it will add to the business.", what does "initiate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: initiate /ɪˈnɪʃ.i.eɪt/ (động từ): khởi xướng, bắt đầu. "Initiate a project/process" = khởi động một dự án/quy trình; danh từ: initiation, initiative.
items.explanationEn: initiate /ɪˈnɪʃ.i.eɪt/ (verb): to start, to begin. "Initiate a project or process" means to start it; related nouns: initiation, initiative.

items.question: Trong câu "The two are intertwined: understanding one reveals the other.", từ "intertwined" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The two are intertwined: understanding one reveals the other.", what does "intertwined" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: intertwined /ˌɪn.təˈtwaɪnd/ (tính từ): đan xen, gắn chặt. "Be intertwined" = gắn bó chặt chẽ, không tách rời; vấn đề và mục tiêu kinh doanh đi liền với nhau.
items.explanationEn: intertwined /ˌɪn.təˈtwaɪnd/ (adjective): closely linked together. "Be intertwined" means closely connected; business problems and objectives go hand in hand.

items.question: Trong câu "Elicit them with two alternating questions", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Elicit them with two alternating questions", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (động từ): khơi gợi, thu thập (thông tin). "Elicit requirements/information" = khai thác yêu cầu/thông tin từ người khác; danh từ: elicitation.
items.explanationEn: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (verb): to draw out information. "Elicit requirements or information" means to draw them out from people; noun: elicitation.

items.question: Trong câu "The process iterates until a list of features emerges — features that would help solve the problems and meet the objectives.", từ "emerge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The process iterates until a list of features emerges — features that would help solve the problems and meet the objectives.", what does "emerge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: emerge /ɪˈmɜːdʒ/ (động từ): xuất hiện, lộ ra. "A pattern/list emerges" = một mẫu/danh sách dần hiện ra sau quá trình phân tích.
items.explanationEn: emerge /ɪˈmɜːdʒ/ (verb): to appear, to come out. "A pattern or list emerges" means it gradually becomes visible through the process.

items.question: Trong câu "Regulatory and legal compliance projects also have clear business objectives — often phrased as risk avoidance: avoid being sued, avoid being put out of business.", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Regulatory and legal compliance projects also have clear business objectives — often phrased as risk avoidance: avoid being sued, avoid being put out of business.", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ (quy định). "Compliance with regulations" = tuân thủ quy định; tính từ: compliant, động từ: comply with.
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (noun): obeying rules or laws. "Compliance with regulations" means obeying them; adjective: compliant, verb: comply with.

items.question: Trong câu "Success metrics indicate whether a project is on track to meet its business objectives.", từ "on track" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Success metrics indicate whether a project is on track to meet its business objectives.", what does "on track" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on track /ɒn træk/ (cụm từ): đúng hướng, đúng tiến độ. "On track to do something" = đang đi đúng hướng để đạt được gì; trái nghĩa: off track.
items.explanationEn: on track /ɒn træk/ (phrase): progressing as planned. "On track to do something" means progressing as needed to achieve it; opposite: off track.

items.question: Trong câu "A vision statement summarises the long-term purpose and intent of the product.", từ "intent" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A vision statement summarises the long-term purpose and intent of the product.", what does "intent" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (danh từ): ý định, mục đích. "Purpose and intent" = mục đích và ý định; "with the intent to…" = với ý định làm gì.
items.explanationEn: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (noun): aim, intention. "Purpose and intent" means what something is for; "with the intent to…" means intending to.

items.question: Trong câu "It can be somewhat idealistic but must stay grounded in existing markets, enterprise architecture, corporate strategic direction, and resource limits.", từ "idealistic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It can be somewhat idealistic but must stay grounded in existing markets, enterprise architecture, corporate strategic direction, and resource limits.", what does "idealistic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: idealistic /ˌaɪ.dɪəˈlɪs.tɪk/ (tính từ): mang tính lý tưởng hóa. Idealistic = hướng tới điều lý tưởng, đôi khi xa thực tế; trái nghĩa gần: realistic, pragmatic.
items.explanationEn: idealistic /ˌaɪ.dɪəˈlɪs.tɪk/ (adjective): aiming at ideal outcomes. Idealistic means aiming at perfect outcomes, sometimes unrealistically; near-opposites: realistic, pragmatic.

items.question: Trong câu "It can be somewhat idealistic but must stay grounded in existing markets, enterprise architecture, corporate strategic direction, and resource limits.", từ "grounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It can be somewhat idealistic but must stay grounded in existing markets, enterprise architecture, corporate strategic direction, and resource limits.", what does "grounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: grounded /ˈɡraʊn.dɪd/ (tính từ): dựa vững trên thực tế. "Grounded in reality/facts" = bám sát thực tế; "grounded" còn có nghĩa bị cấm túc hoặc được nối đất.
items.explanationEn: grounded /ˈɡraʊn.dɪd/ (adjective): based firmly on reality. "Grounded in reality or facts" means firmly based on them; it can also mean punished or earthed.

items.question: Trong câu "Comparing the results is an excellent way to spot different understandings of the project objectives.", từ "spot" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Comparing the results is an excellent way to spot different understandings of the project objectives.", what does "spot" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spot /spɒt/ (động từ): phát hiện, nhận ra. "Spot a difference/mistake" = phát hiện sự khác biệt/lỗi; danh từ "spot" là vết hoặc chỗ.
items.explanationEn: spot /spɒt/ (verb): to notice, to detect. "Spot a difference or mistake" means to notice it; the noun "spot" is a mark or a place.

items.question: Trong câu "And it is never too late — even mid-project, crafting a vision statement helps keep the remaining work in focus.", từ "craft" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "And it is never too late — even mid-project, crafting a vision statement helps keep the remaining work in focus.", what does "craft" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make with care and skill
items.explanation: craft /krɑːft/ (động từ): soạn thảo công phu. "Craft a statement/message" = soạn một tuyên bố/thông điệp cẩn thận, có chủ đích.
items.explanationEn: craft /krɑːft/ (verb): to make with care and skill. "Craft a statement or message" means to write it carefully and skilfully.

items.question: Trong câu "For each risk, estimate the potential loss, the likelihood of occurring, and any mitigation actions.", từ "likelihood" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For each risk, estimate the potential loss, the likelihood of occurring, and any mitigation actions.", what does "likelihood" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: likelihood /ˈlaɪ.kli.hʊd/ (danh từ): khả năng xảy ra. "The likelihood of something happening" = xác suất điều đó xảy ra; thường đi cùng impact khi đánh giá rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: likelihood /ˈlaɪ.kli.hʊd/ (noun): the chance of happening. "The likelihood of something happening" is its probability; paired with impact when rating risks.

items.question: Trong câu "For each risk, estimate the potential loss, the likelihood of occurring, and any mitigation actions.", từ "mitigation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For each risk, estimate the potential loss, the likelihood of occurring, and any mitigation actions.", what does "mitigation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mitigation /ˌmɪt.ɪˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự giảm nhẹ, giảm thiểu. "Risk mitigation" = giảm thiểu rủi ro; động từ: mitigate a risk. Đừng nhầm với migration.
items.explanationEn: mitigation /ˌmɪt.ɪˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): reducing harm or severity. "Risk mitigation" means reducing a risk; verb: mitigate. Do not confuse it with migration.

items.question: Trong câu "An assumption is a statement believed to be true in the absence of proof or definitive knowledge.", từ "in the absence of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An assumption is a statement believed to be true in the absence of proof or definitive knowledge.", what does "in the absence of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in the absence of /ɪn ði ˈæb.səns ɒv/ (cụm từ): khi không có, thiếu. "In the absence of evidence" = khi không có bằng chứng; đây chính là đặc điểm của một giả định.
items.explanationEn: in the absence of /ɪn ði ˈæb.səns ɒv/ (phrase): when something is lacking. "In the absence of evidence" means when there is no evidence; that is what makes something an assumption.

items.question: Trong câu "An assumption is a statement believed to be true in the absence of proof or definitive knowledge.", từ "definitive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An assumption is a statement believed to be true in the absence of proof or definitive knowledge.", what does "definitive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: definitive /dɪˈfɪn.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): chắc chắn, dứt khoát. "Definitive answer/knowledge" = câu trả lời/hiểu biết chắc chắn; khác với "definite" (rõ ràng).
items.explanationEn: definitive /dɪˈfɪn.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): final and certain. "A definitive answer or knowledge" is conclusive and final; compare "definite" (clear, certain).

items.question: Trong câu "A dependency is a reliance on an external factor: a pending industry standard, government regulation, a deliverable from another project, a third-party supplier, or a development partner.", từ "reliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A dependency is a reliance on an external factor: a pending industry standard, government regulation, a deliverable from another project, a third-party supplier, or a development partner.", what does "reliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reliance /rɪˈlaɪ.əns/ (danh từ): sự phụ thuộc, dựa vào. "Reliance on something" = sự phụ thuộc vào điều gì; động từ: rely on.
items.explanationEn: reliance /rɪˈlaɪ.əns/ (noun): dependence on something. "Reliance on something" means depending on it; verb: rely on.

items.question: Trong câu "A dependency is a reliance on an external factor: a pending industry standard, government regulation, a deliverable from another project, a third-party supplier, or a development partner.", từ "pending" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A dependency is a reliance on an external factor: a pending industry standard, government regulation, a deliverable from another project, a third-party supplier, or a development partner.", what does "pending" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pending /ˈpen.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): đang chờ quyết định. "Pending standard/approval" = tiêu chuẩn/phê duyệt đang chờ, chưa chốt; trạng thái "pending" rất hay gặp trong phần mềm.
items.explanationEn: pending /ˈpen.dɪŋ/ (adjective): not yet decided or settled. "A pending standard or approval" is still awaiting a decision; "pending" is a common status in software.

items.question: Trong câu "A dependency is a reliance on an external factor: a pending industry standard, government regulation, a deliverable from another project, a third-party supplier, or a development partner.", từ "deliverable" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A dependency is a reliance on an external factor: a pending industry standard, government regulation, a deliverable from another project, a third-party supplier, or a development partner.", what does "deliverable" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an output to be handed over
items.explanation: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (danh từ): sản phẩm cần bàn giao. "Project deliverables" = các sản phẩm/kết quả phải bàn giao (tài liệu, phần mềm, báo cáo).
items.explanationEn: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (noun): an output to be handed over. "Project deliverables" are the outputs that must be handed over, such as documents or software.

items.question: Trong câu "Project risks typically centre on resource availability and technology factors.", từ "centre on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Project risks typically centre on resource availability and technology factors.", what does "centre on" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to focus on, to revolve around
items.explanation: centre on /ˈsen.tər ɒn/ (cụm từ): tập trung vào, xoay quanh. "Centre on / center on something" = xoay quanh điều gì; tương tự focus on.
items.explanationEn: centre on /ˈsen.tər ɒn/ (phrase): to focus on, to revolve around. "Centre on (center on) something" means to have it as the main focus; similar to focus on.

items.question: Trong câu "Limitations itemise capabilities the product will not include that some people might assume will be there.", từ "itemise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Limitations itemise capabilities the product will not include that some people might assume will be there.", what does "itemise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: itemise /ˈaɪ.tə.maɪz/ (động từ): liệt kê từng mục. "Itemise (itemize) the costs/limits" = liệt kê chi tiết từng khoản/giới hạn.
items.explanationEn: itemise /ˈaɪ.tə.maɪz/ (verb): to list item by item. "Itemise (itemize) costs or limits" means to list each one separately.

items.question: Trong câu "Major features — each with a unique, persistent label so it can be traced.", từ "persistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Major features — each with a unique, persistent label so it can be traced.", what does "persistent" (adjective) mean?
options: tạm thời, thay đổi liên tục
cố định, tồn tại lâu dài
items.explanation: persistent /pəˈsɪs.tənt/ (tính từ): cố định, tồn tại lâu dài. "Persistent label/ID" = nhãn/mã không đổi theo thời gian; với người, persistent nghĩa là kiên trì.
items.explanationEn: persistent /pəˈsɪs.tənt/ (adjective): lasting, not changing. "A persistent label or ID" stays the same over time; of a person, persistent means determined.

items.question: Trong câu "Scope of subsequent releases — a roadmap; the farther out, the fuzzier, and it will certainly change.", từ "subsequent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope of subsequent releases — a roadmap; the farther out, the fuzzier, and it will certainly change.", what does "subsequent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: subsequent /ˈsʌb.sɪ.kwənt/ (tính từ): tiếp theo, sau đó. "Subsequent releases/steps" = các bản phát hành/bước tiếp theo; trạng từ: subsequently.
items.explanationEn: subsequent /ˈsʌb.sɪ.kwənt/ (adjective): coming after, following. "Subsequent releases or steps" are the ones that follow; adverb: subsequently.

items.question: Trong câu "Scope of subsequent releases — a roadmap; the farther out, the fuzzier, and it will certainly change.", từ "fuzzy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope of subsequent releases — a roadmap; the farther out, the fuzzier, and it will certainly change.", what does "fuzzy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fuzzy /ˈfʌz.i/ (tính từ): mờ nhạt, không rõ ràng. "The farther out, the fuzzier" = càng xa trong tương lai càng mờ nhạt; nghĩa đen là có lông tơ.
items.explanationEn: fuzzy /ˈfʌz.i/ (adjective): unclear, not well defined. "The farther out, the fuzzier" means the more distant, the less clear; literally fuzzy means covered in soft hair.

items.question: Trong câu "Limitations and exclusions — including items that were cut from scope, so the decision is not forgotten.", từ "exclusion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Limitations and exclusions — including items that were cut from scope, so the decision is not forgotten.", what does "exclusion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: exclusion /ɪkˈskluː.ʒən/ (danh từ): điều bị loại trừ. "Limitations and exclusions" = giới hạn và những thứ bị loại khỏi phạm vi; động từ: exclude.
items.explanationEn: exclusion /ɪkˈskluː.ʒən/ (noun): something left out. "Limitations and exclusions" are limits and items left out of scope; verb: exclude.

items.question: Trong câu "One product company suffered near-catastrophic scope creep.", từ "catastrophic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One product company suffered near-catastrophic scope creep.", what does "catastrophic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: catastrophic /ˌkæt.əˈstrɒf.ɪk/ (tính từ): thảm khốc, tai hại. "Near-catastrophic" = gần như thảm họa; danh từ: catastrophe.
items.explanationEn: catastrophic /ˌkæt.əˈstrɒf.ɪk/ (adjective): disastrous, very harmful. "Near-catastrophic" means almost disastrous; noun: catastrophe.

items.question: Trong câu "Their manager said ruefully", từ "ruefully" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Their manager said ruefully", what does "ruefully" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: ruefully /ˈruː.fəl.i/ (trạng từ): một cách tiếc nuối. "Say ruefully" = nói với vẻ hối tiếc, hơi tự giễu; tính từ: rueful.
items.explanationEn: ruefully /ˈruː.fəl.i/ (adverb): with regret. "Say ruefully" means to speak with regret, often slightly self-mocking; adjective: rueful.

items.question: Trong câu "They had a solid product vision, but they did not manage scope by planning a series of releases and deferring some features.", từ "defer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They had a solid product vision, but they did not manage scope by planning a series of releases and deferring some features.", what does "defer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defer /dɪˈfɜːr/ (động từ): hoãn lại, dời sau. "Defer a feature" = hoãn tính năng sang bản sau; "defer to someone" lại là nghe theo ý kiến người đó.
items.explanationEn: defer /dɪˈfɜːr/ (verb): to postpone, to put off. "Defer a feature" means to postpone it; "defer to someone" means to accept their judgement.

items.question: Trong câu "They released an overinflated product after four years.", từ "overinflated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They released an overinflated product after four years.", what does "overinflated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: overinflated /ˌəʊ.vər.ɪnˈfleɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): phình to quá mức. "Overinflated product/expectations" = sản phẩm/kỳ vọng bị thổi phồng quá mức.
items.explanationEn: overinflated /ˌəʊ.vər.ɪnˈfleɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): made too big, bloated. "An overinflated product or expectations" are bloated or exaggerated beyond what is useful.

items.question: Trong câu "On the first release, one team made a very clear-eyed decision: users had to be able to run their delivery business with version 1.", từ "clear-eyed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On the first release, one team made a very clear-eyed decision: users had to be able to run their delivery business with version 1.", what does "clear-eyed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: clear-eyed /ˌklɪərˈaɪd/ (tính từ): sáng suốt, tỉnh táo. "Clear-eyed decision/view" = quyết định/cái nhìn thực tế, không ảo tưởng.
items.explanationEn: clear-eyed /ˌklɪərˈaɪd/ (adjective): realistic and sensible. "A clear-eyed decision or view" is realistic and free of illusions.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not neglect nonfunctional requirements in the initial release.", từ "neglect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not neglect nonfunctional requirements in the initial release.", what does "neglect" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fail to pay attention to
items.explanation: neglect /nɪˈɡlekt/ (động từ): xao nhãng, bỏ bê. "Neglect requirements/duties" = bỏ bê yêu cầu/nhiệm vụ; tính từ: negligent.
items.explanationEn: neglect /nɪˈɡlekt/ (verb): to fail to pay attention to. "Neglect requirements or duties" means to fail to give them attention; adjective: negligent.

items.question: Trong câu "The ones that directly affect architecture are critical from the outset — rearchitecting to fix quality deficiencies can cost almost as much as a total rewrite.", từ "from the outset" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The ones that directly affect architecture are critical from the outset — rearchitecting to fix quality deficiencies can cost almost as much as a total rewrite.", what does "from the outset" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: from the outset /frɒm ði ˈaʊt.set/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "From the outset" = ngay từ khi bắt đầu; tương đương from the start / from the beginning.
items.explanationEn: from the outset /frɒm ði ˈaʊt.set/ (phrase): from the very start. "From the outset" means from the start; same as from the beginning.

items.question: Trong câu "The ones that directly affect architecture are critical from the outset — rearchitecting to fix quality deficiencies can cost almost as much as a total rewrite.", từ "deficiency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The ones that directly affect architecture are critical from the outset — rearchitecting to fix quality deficiencies can cost almost as much as a total rewrite.", what does "deficiency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deficiency /dɪˈfɪʃ.ən.si/ (danh từ): sự thiếu sót, khiếm khuyết. "Quality deficiencies" = khiếm khuyết về chất lượng; tính từ: deficient. Đừng nhầm với deficit (thâm hụt).
items.explanationEn: deficiency /dɪˈfɪʃ.ən.si/ (noun): a lack or shortcoming. "Quality deficiencies" are shortcomings in quality; adjective: deficient. Compare deficit (a money shortfall).

items.question: Trong câu "A context diagram visually illustrates the boundary between the system you are building and everything else.", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A context diagram visually illustrates the boundary between the system you are building and everything else.", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (danh từ): ranh giới, đường biên. "System boundary" = ranh giới hệ thống, phân tách cái nằm trong và ngoài phạm vi.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (noun): a dividing line, a limit. "The system boundary" separates what is inside the system from what is outside.

items.question: Trong câu "It identifies external entities (also called terminators) outside the system, plus the data, control, and material flows between them and the system.", từ "entity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It identifies external entities (also called terminators) outside the system, plus the data, control, and material flows between them and the system.", what does "entity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: entity /ˈen.tɪ.ti/ (danh từ): thực thể. "External entity" = thực thể bên ngoài (người dùng, tổ chức, hệ thống khác) tương tác với hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: entity /ˈen.tɪ.ti/ (noun): a distinct thing that exists. "An external entity" is a person, organisation or system outside that interacts with the system.

items.question: Trong câu "The entire system is drawn as a single circle — the context diagram deliberately provides no visibility into internals.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The entire system is drawn as a single circle — the context diagram deliberately provides no visibility into internals.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (trạng từ): một cách cố ý. Deliberately = có chủ đích; "deliberately simple" = cố tình làm đơn giản. Trái nghĩa: accidentally.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (adverb): on purpose. Deliberately means on purpose; "deliberately simple" means kept simple by design. Opposite: accidentally.

items.question: Trong câu "inside the circle can encompass any combination of software, hardware, and manual human operations", từ "encompass" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "inside the circle can encompass any combination of software, hardware, and manual human operations", what does "encompass" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: encompass /ɪnˈkʌm.pəs/ (động từ): bao gồm, bao quát. "Encompass a wide range of…" = bao gồm nhiều thứ; gần nghĩa với include, cover.
items.explanationEn: encompass /ɪnˈkʌm.pəs/ (verb): to include, to cover. "Encompass a wide range of…" means to include many things; close to include or cover.

items.question: Trong câu "How to scope with it: find the systems that consume data from yours.", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to scope with it: find the systems that consume data from yours.", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (động từ): tiếp nhận và sử dụng. "Consume data/an API" = nhận và dùng dữ liệu/API; người/hệ thống dùng gọi là consumer.
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (verb): to take in and use. "Consume data or an API" means to receive and use it; the user is called a consumer.

items.question: Trong câu "This matters because a system may not connect directly to yours yet still receive your data through an intermediary — and you must still consider the requirements that arise from it.", từ "intermediary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This matters because a system may not connect directly to yours yet still receive your data through an intermediary — and you must still consider the requirements that arise from it.", what does "intermediary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: intermediary /ˌɪn.təˈmiː.di.ə.ri/ (danh từ): bên trung gian. "Through an intermediary" = thông qua một bên trung gian; tính từ intermediate = trung cấp, ở giữa.
items.explanationEn: intermediary /ˌɪn.təˈmiː.di.ə.ri/ (noun): a go-between. "Through an intermediary" means via a go-between; compare intermediate (in the middle).

items.question: Trong câu "This matters because a system may not connect directly to yours yet still receive your data through an intermediary — and you must still consider the requirements that arise from it.", từ "arise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This matters because a system may not connect directly to yours yet still receive your data through an intermediary — and you must still consider the requirements that arise from it.", what does "arise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: arise /əˈraɪz/ (động từ): phát sinh, nảy sinh. "Arise from something" = phát sinh từ điều gì; "problems arise" = vấn đề nảy sinh.
items.explanationEn: arise /əˈraɪz/ (verb): to come about, to result. "Arise from something" means to result from it; "problems arise" means problems appear.

items.question: Trong câu "A feature tree is a visual depiction of the product features, grouped logically and subdivided into up to three levels", từ "depiction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A feature tree is a visual depiction of the product features, grouped logically and subdivided into up to three levels", what does "depiction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: depiction /dɪˈpɪk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự thể hiện, mô tả. "A visual depiction of…" = một hình ảnh thể hiện điều gì; động từ: depict.
items.explanationEn: depiction /dɪˈpɪk.ʃən/ (noun): a representation, portrayal. "A visual depiction of…" is a picture that represents something; verb: depict.

items.question: Trong câu "The feature tree gives a concise view of the whole scope, making it the ideal model to show executives who want a quick glance at the project.", từ "concise" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The feature tree gives a concise view of the whole scope, making it the ideal model to show executives who want a quick glance at the project.", what does "concise" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concise /kənˈsaɪs/ (tính từ): ngắn gọn, súc tích. "Concise view/summary" = cái nhìn/tóm tắt ngắn gọn mà vẫn đủ ý; trái nghĩa: verbose.
items.explanationEn: concise /kənˈsaɪs/ (adjective): brief but complete. "A concise view or summary" is short but complete; opposite: verbose.

items.question: Trong câu "The feature tree gives a concise view of the whole scope, making it the ideal model to show executives who want a quick glance at the project.", từ "glance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The feature tree gives a concise view of the whole scope, making it the ideal model to show executives who want a quick glance at the project.", what does "glance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: glance /ɡlɑːns/ (danh từ): cái nhìn lướt qua. "A quick glance at…" = liếc nhanh qua; "at a glance" = chỉ cần nhìn qua là thấy.
items.explanationEn: glance /ɡlɑːns/ (noun): a quick look. "A quick glance at…" is a brief look; "at a glance" means immediately, with one look.

items.question: Trong câu "An event list identifies external events that could trigger behaviour in the system.", từ "trigger" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An event list identifies external events that could trigger behaviour in the system.", what does "trigger" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ər/ (động từ): kích hoạt, gây ra. "Trigger an event/behaviour" = kích hoạt sự kiện/hành vi; danh từ trigger còn là cò súng.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ər/ (verb): to cause to start. "Trigger an event or behaviour" means to set it off; the noun trigger is also part of a gun.

items.question: Trong câu "The event list is a useful scoping tool because you can allocate individual events to specific releases or iterations.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The event list is a useful scoping tool because you can allocate individual events to specific releases or iterations.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (động từ): phân bổ, phân chia. "Allocate something to…" = phân bổ cái gì cho…; danh từ: allocation. Đừng nhầm với locate.
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (verb): to assign, to distribute. "Allocate something to…" means to assign it; noun: allocation. Do not confuse with locate.

items.question: Trong câu "These models complement and cross-check each other", từ "complement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These models complement and cross-check each other", what does "complement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: complement /ˈkɒm.plɪ.ment/ (động từ): bổ sung cho nhau. "Complement each other" = bổ trợ lẫn nhau; đừng nhầm với compliment (khen ngợi), phát âm giống nhau.
items.explanationEn: complement /ˈkɒm.plɪ.ment/ (verb): to complete each other. "Complement each other" means to fill each other's gaps; do not confuse with compliment (to praise).

items.question: Trong câu "If you find a disconnect, check whether a model is missing an element.", từ "disconnect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you find a disconnect, check whether a model is missing an element.", what does "disconnect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: disconnect /ˌdɪs.kəˈnekt/ (danh từ): sự không khớp, lệch nhau. "A disconnect between A and B" = sự không nhất quán giữa A và B; nghĩa kỹ thuật khác: mất kết nối.
items.explanationEn: disconnect /ˌdɪs.kəˈnekt/ (noun): a mismatch, a gap. "A disconnect between A and B" is a mismatch between them; technically it can also mean a lost connection.

items.question: Trong câu "Sometimes the disconnect is legitimate", từ "legitimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sometimes the disconnect is legitimate", what does "legitimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legitimate /lɪˈdʒɪt.ɪ.mət/ (tính từ): hợp lý, chính đáng. "A legitimate reason/concern" = lý do/mối lo chính đáng; nghĩa khác: hợp pháp.
items.explanationEn: legitimate /lɪˈdʒɪt.ɪ.mət/ (adjective): justified, valid. "A legitimate reason or concern" is a valid one; it can also mean lawful.

items.question: Trong câu "The major value or benefit the stakeholder receives: improved productivity, reduced rework and waste, cost savings, streamlined processes, automation of manual tasks, the ability to perform entirely new tasks, compliance with regulations, or improved usability over current products.", từ "streamlined" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The major value or benefit the stakeholder receives: improved productivity, reduced rework and waste, cost savings, streamlined processes, automation of manual tasks, the ability to perform entirely new tasks, compliance with regulations, or improved usability over current products.", what does "streamlined" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: streamlined /ˈstriːm.laɪnd/ (tính từ): tinh gọn, hợp lý hóa. "Streamlined process" = quy trình đã được tinh gọn, bỏ bước thừa; động từ: streamline.
items.explanationEn: streamlined /ˈstriːm.laɪnd/ (adjective): simplified and efficient. "A streamlined process" has had unnecessary steps removed; verb: streamline.

items.question: Trong câu "Any known constraints that must be accommodated.", từ "accommodate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Any known constraints that must be accommodated.", what does "accommodate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accommodate /əˈkɒm.ə.deɪt/ (động từ): đáp ứng, tính đến. "Accommodate constraints/needs" = đáp ứng hoặc tính đến ràng buộc/nhu cầu; nghĩa khác: cho ở trọ.
items.explanationEn: accommodate /əˈkɒm.ə.deɪt/ (verb): to take into account. "Accommodate constraints or needs" means to allow for them; it can also mean to provide lodging.

items.question: Trong câu "Not all five dimensions can be constraints, and they cannot all be drivers.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not all five dimensions can be constraints, and they cannot all be drivers.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. "Operate within constraints" = làm việc trong các giới hạn; "time constraint" = giới hạn thời gian.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limit, a restriction. "Operate within constraints" means working within limits; "time constraint" is a limit on time.

items.question: Trong câu "A factor the PM has latitude to adjust and balance against the others", từ "latitude" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A factor the PM has latitude to adjust and balance against the others", what does "latitude" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: latitude /ˈlæt.ɪ.tjuːd/ (danh từ): quyền tự do xoay xở. "Have latitude to do something" = có quyền tự do quyết định làm gì; trong địa lý latitude là vĩ độ.
items.explanationEn: latitude /ˈlæt.ɪ.tjuːd/ (noun): freedom to decide or act. "Have latitude to do something" means freedom to choose how; in geography latitude is north-south position.

items.question: Trong câu "The project manager needs some degrees of freedom to respond when requirements or project realities change.", từ "degree of freedom" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The project manager needs some degrees of freedom to respond when requirements or project realities change.", what does "degree of freedom" (phrase) mean?
options: bằng cấp về luật nhân quyền
mức độ linh hoạt được điều chỉnh
items.explanation: degree of freedom /dɪˌɡriː əv ˈfriː.dəm/ (cụm từ): mức độ linh hoạt được điều chỉnh. "Degree of freedom" = yếu tố còn có thể điều chỉnh linh hoạt; trong kỹ thuật/thống kê là bậc tự do.
items.explanationEn: degree of freedom /dɪˌɡriː əv ˈfriː.dəm/ (phrase): room to adjust something. "A degree of freedom" is a factor that can still be adjusted; in engineering and statistics it is a free variable.

items.question: Trong câu "When marketing suddenly demands release a month earlier, this priority table decides the response: defer requirements to a later release, shorten the system test cycle, demand overtime or hire contractors, or shift resources from other projects.", từ "contractor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When marketing suddenly demands release a month earlier, this priority table decides the response: defer requirements to a later release, shorten the system test cycle, demand overtime or hire contractors, or shift resources from other projects.", what does "contractor" (noun) mean?
options: người/nhà thầu làm theo hợp đồng
nhân viên chính thức lâu năm
items.explanation: contractor /kənˈtræk.tər/ (danh từ): người/nhà thầu làm theo hợp đồng. "Hire contractors" = thuê người làm theo hợp đồng ngắn hạn thay vì tuyển chính thức.
items.explanationEn: contractor /kənˈtræk.tər/ (noun): someone hired on contract. "Hire contractors" means bringing in people on contract instead of permanent staff.

items.question: Trong câu "A scope definition is a STRUCTURE, not a straitjacket.", từ "straitjacket" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A scope definition is a STRUCTURE, not a straitjacket.", what does "straitjacket" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a clear plan for the future
items.explanation: straitjacket /ˈstreɪt.dʒæk.ɪt/ (danh từ): sự gò bó, trói buộc. Nghĩa đen là áo trói (cho người bệnh); nghĩa bóng: thứ gò bó quá chặt. Phạm vi là khung, không phải xiềng xích.
items.explanationEn: straitjacket /ˈstreɪt.dʒæk.ɪt/ (noun): something that restricts too much. Literally a jacket that restrains the arms; figuratively anything too restrictive. Scope guides, it does not bind.

items.question: Trong câu "Scope change is not a bad thing if it steers the project toward satisfying evolving customer needs.", từ "steer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope change is not a bad thing if it steers the project toward satisfying evolving customer needs.", what does "steer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: steer /stɪər/ (động từ): lái, dẫn dắt. "Steer something toward…" = lái/dẫn điều gì theo hướng…; "steering committee" = ban chỉ đạo.
items.explanationEn: steer /stɪər/ (verb): to guide, to direct. "Steer something toward…" means to guide it in that direction; "steering committee" is a guiding group.

items.question: Trong câu "Problems arise only when change happens unconsciously and uncontrolled.", từ "unconsciously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Problems arise only when change happens unconsciously and uncontrolled.", what does "unconsciously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: unconsciously /ʌnˈkɒn.ʃəs.li/ (trạng từ): một cách vô thức. Unconsciously = không nhận thức được; thay đổi phạm vi mà không ai để ý là nguồn gốc của scope creep.
items.explanationEn: unconsciously /ʌnˈkɒn.ʃəs.li/ (adverb): without awareness. Unconsciously means without being aware; unnoticed scope changes are the root of scope creep.

items.question: Trong câu "It can go into the current project if its priority is high relative to already-committed requirements — which usually means deferring or cancelling something else, unless you extend the project.", từ "relative to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It can go into the current project if its priority is high relative to already-committed requirements — which usually means deferring or cancelling something else, unless you extend the project.", what does "relative to" (phrase) mean?
options: so với, trong tương quan với
items.explanation: relative to /ˈrel.ə.tɪv tuː/ (cụm từ): so với, trong tương quan với. "High relative to X" = cao khi so với X; danh từ relative còn nghĩa là họ hàng.
items.explanationEn: relative to /ˈrel.ə.tɪv tuː/ (phrase): compared with. "High relative to X" means high compared with X; the noun relative also means a family member.

items.question: Trong câu "Where possible, quantify the contribution: does this feature contribute roughly 1,000, 100,000, or 1,000,000 toward an objective?", từ "quantify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Where possible, quantify the contribution: does this feature contribute roughly 1,000, 100,000, or 1,000,000 toward an objective?", what does "quantify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: quantify /ˈkwɒn.tɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): định lượng, đo bằng số. "Quantify the benefit/impact" = đo lường lợi ích/tác động bằng con số; tính từ: quantitative.
items.explanationEn: quantify /ˈkwɒn.tɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to express as a number. "Quantify the benefit or impact" means to put a number on it; adjective: quantitative.

items.question: Trong câu "Rejected requirements have a way of reappearing, and you will want to know why you said no last time.", từ "have a way of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rejected requirements have a way of reappearing, and you will want to know why you said no last time.", what does "have a way of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: have a way of /hæv ə weɪ ɒv/ (cụm từ): thường hay, có xu hướng. "Have a way of doing something" = thường hay xảy ra như vậy (dù không ai muốn).
items.explanationEn: have a way of /hæv ə weɪ ɒv/ (phrase): to tend to happen. "Have a way of doing something" means it tends to happen, often unwelcome.

items.question: Trong câu "When scope increases, the PM usually must renegotiate budget, resources, schedule, or staff.", từ "renegotiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When scope increases, the PM usually must renegotiate budget, resources, schedule, or staff.", what does "renegotiate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: renegotiate /ˌriː.nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/ (động từ): đàm phán lại. "Renegotiate the budget/contract" = thương lượng lại ngân sách/hợp đồng khi điều kiện thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: renegotiate /ˌriː.nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/ (verb): to discuss terms again. "Renegotiate the budget or contract" means to agree new terms when conditions change.

items.question: Trong câu "Ideally the original schedule already contains contingency buffers.", từ "contingency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ideally the original schedule already contains contingency buffers.", what does "contingency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: contingency /kənˈtɪn.dʒən.si/ (danh từ): sự dự phòng bất trắc. "Contingency buffer/plan" = khoảng đệm/kế hoạch dự phòng cho tình huống bất ngờ.
items.explanationEn: contingency /kənˈtɪn.dʒən.si/ (noun): provision for the unexpected. "A contingency buffer or plan" is set aside for unexpected events.

items.question: Trong câu "Each iteration scope consists of user stories selected from a dynamic product backlog, based on priority and the team estimated delivery capacity for the timebox.", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each iteration scope consists of user stories selected from a dynamic product backlog, based on priority and the team estimated delivery capacity for the timebox.", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
options: năng lực, khả năng đáp ứng
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (danh từ): năng lực, khả năng đáp ứng. "Delivery capacity" = khối lượng việc đội có thể hoàn thành; "in my capacity as…" = với tư cách là…
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (noun): the amount one can deliver. "Delivery capacity" is how much work a team can finish; "in my capacity as…" means in my role as.

items.question: Trong câu "The number of iterations — and therefore the overall duration — still depends on the total functionality, but each iteration scope is controlled to ensure timely completion.", từ "timely" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The number of iterations — and therefore the overall duration — still depends on the total functionality, but each iteration scope is controlled to ensure timely completion.", what does "timely" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: timely /ˈtaɪm.li/ (tính từ): đúng lúc, kịp thời. "Timely completion/response" = hoàn thành/phản hồi kịp thời; lưu ý timely là tính từ dù có đuôi -ly.
items.explanationEn: timely /ˈtaɪm.li/ (adjective): happening on time. "Timely completion or response" happens at the right time; note timely is an adjective despite -ly.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile projects often run an iteration zero — an upfront planning cycle to define the product vision and other business requirements.", từ "upfront" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile projects often run an iteration zero — an upfront planning cycle to define the product vision and other business requirements.", what does "upfront" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: upfront /ʌpˈfrʌnt/ (tính từ): diễn ra trước, ban đầu. "Upfront planning/cost" = lập kế hoạch/chi phí bỏ ra từ đầu; "be upfront about" = thẳng thắn về.
items.explanationEn: upfront /ʌpˈfrʌnt/ (adjective): done at the beginning. "Upfront planning or cost" happens at the start; "be upfront about something" means to be frank.

items.question: Trong câu "The project manager steers the project to completion, but the BA understands the business objectives most intimately and can determine when the desired value has been delivered — meaning the work is done.", từ "intimately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The project manager steers the project to completion, but the BA understands the business objectives most intimately and can determine when the desired value has been delivered — meaning the work is done.", what does "intimately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: intimately /ˈɪn.tɪ.mət.li/ (trạng từ): một cách tường tận. "Know something intimately" = hiểu điều gì rất sâu sắc, tường tận; nghĩa khác: thân mật, riêng tư.
items.explanationEn: intimately /ˈɪn.tɪ.mət.li/ (adverb): in close detail. "Know something intimately" means to know it in close detail; it can also mean in a private, personal way.

items.question: Trong câu "Vague business objectives guarantee an open-ended project with no way to know when you are done.", từ "open-ended" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Vague business objectives guarantee an open-ended project with no way to know when you are done.", what does "open-ended" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: open-ended /ˌəʊ.pənˈen.dɪd/ (tính từ): không có điểm kết thúc. "Open-ended project/question" = dự án không có điểm dừng rõ ràng / câu hỏi mở.
items.explanationEn: open-ended /ˌəʊ.pənˈen.dɪd/ (adjective): with no fixed end. "An open-ended project or question" has no fixed limit or single answer.

items.question: Trong câu "Business objectives must be measurable; unverifiable platitudes are useless.", từ "platitude" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Business objectives must be measurable; unverifiable platitudes are useless.", what does "platitude" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: platitude /ˈplæt.ɪ.tjuːd/ (danh từ): lời nói sáo rỗng. Platitude = câu nói nghe hay nhưng rỗng tuếch, như "trở thành nhà cung cấp đẳng cấp thế giới".
items.explanationEn: platitude /ˈplæt.ɪ.tjuːd/ (noun): an empty, overused remark. A platitude sounds good but says nothing measurable, like "become a world-class provider".

items.question: Trong câu "Have several stakeholders write the vision statement separately, then compare — the fastest way to expose mismatched understanding.", từ "mismatched" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Have several stakeholders write the vision statement separately, then compare — the fastest way to expose mismatched understanding.", what does "mismatched" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mismatched /ˌmɪsˈmætʃt/ (tính từ): không khớp nhau. "Mismatched understanding/expectations" = cách hiểu/kỳ vọng không khớp nhau giữa các bên.
items.explanationEn: mismatched /ˌmɪsˈmætʃt/ (adjective): not matching. "Mismatched understanding or expectations" means the parties do not see things the same way.

items.question: Trong câu "A wrong assumption can defeat a business objective even when the software works perfectly.", từ "defeat" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A wrong assumption can defeat a business objective even when the software works perfectly.", what does "defeat" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defeat /dɪˈfiːt/ (động từ): làm thất bại, phá hỏng. "Defeat the purpose/objective" = làm mất tác dụng của mục đích/mục tiêu; nghĩa thường gặp: đánh bại.
items.explanationEn: defeat /dɪˈfiːt/ (verb): to cause to fail. "Defeat the purpose or objective" means to make it fail; its everyday sense is to beat an opponent.

items.question: Trong câu "State explicitly what the product will not do, including anything cut from scope.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State explicitly what the product will not do, including anything cut from scope.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách ngầm, không nói ra
một cách tạm thời, nhất thời
một cách rõ ràng, tường minh
một cách bí mật, lén lút
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ ràng, tường minh. "State explicitly" = nêu rõ ràng, không để người khác tự suy đoán; trái nghĩa: implicitly.
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): clearly and directly. "State explicitly" means to say it clearly, leaving nothing to guesswork; opposite: implicitly.

items.question: Trong câu "Use business objectives as the yardstick for every scope decision, and success metrics to know when the project is done.", từ "yardstick" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use business objectives as the yardstick for every scope decision, and success metrics to know when the project is done.", what does "yardstick" (noun) mean?
options: thước đo, tiêu chuẩn so sánh
cây gậy chống khi đi bộ
items.explanation: yardstick /ˈjɑːd.stɪk/ (danh từ): thước đo, tiêu chuẩn so sánh. Nghĩa đen là cây thước dài một yard; nghĩa bóng: tiêu chuẩn để đánh giá mọi quyết định.
items.explanationEn: yardstick /ˈjɑːd.stɪk/ (noun): a standard for judging. Literally a one-yard measuring stick; figuratively a standard used to judge decisions.
